intro: Tuesday. 4:52 PM. You took the stairs because the elevator smelled like rain.
Between the third floor and the second there was one step too many. Your foot went through it like wet paper.
You fell for a long time. Long enough to get bored. Then: carpet.
This is the floor under the floor. The place where the world keeps its wiring. Somebody left the lights on.
Somewhere down here is a door marked EXIT 0. Zero means clean. Zero means it worked.
ending: The door opens on cold air and a sound you forgot existed: nothing. No hum.
You step through. The stairs on the other side only go down.

teaser.title: MAINTENANCE LEVEL 1
teaser.body: The Damp Archive. Being built now. Your exit code is saved.

halls.name: THE YELLOW HALLS
halls.blurb: The carpet is damp. The lights hum a note you almost know.

office.name: DEAD OFFICE
office.blurb: Nobody has worked here for a long time. The chairs still face the desks.

closet.name: LOCKER CLOSET
closet.blurb: Somebody's coffee mug. Somebody's coat. Nobody.

tenant.name: ROOM 0B
tenant.blurb: Something stood here so long the carpet wore through.

maint.name: BREAKER CORRIDOR
maint.blurb: Concrete and cold air. The hum drops an octave down here.

breaker.name: BREAKER ROOM
breaker.blurb: Every switch has a label. Some labels are lies.

pipes.name: PIPE GALLERY
pipes.blurb: Pipes climb into the dark. Something gurgles inside them, patiently.

flood.name: FLOODED UTILITY
flood.blurb: Ankle-deep and very still. The pump is off. Keep it off.

exit.name: EXIT 0
exit.blurb: The green light is warm. That's new.

interact.text: Use what you look at. Some things need you to hold.

inventory.text: Your pockets. Read your notes again here.

flashlight.text: Flashlight. Some rooms have no power.

view.text: Switch between first and third person.

listen.text: It listens for running feet. Walk and it stays asleep.

text.fake.exit1: Behind the door: brick. Somebody painted EXIT 1 on it, too.
text.fake.exit2: Brick. A crayon arrow points back the way you came.
text.fake.exit7: Brick, and a second door painted on the brick. It doesn't open either.
text.gate.locked: The gate won't move. A dead motor box says GATE PWR: B4.
text.gate.look: Through the gate: a green sign. EXIT 0. It's right there.
text.gate.open: Somewhere a motor groans. The gate is rolling up.
text.locked.maint: Locked. The keyhole is brass and very clean.
text.open.maint: The key turns. Cold air comes out of the door.
text.brk.dead: The switch clacks. Nothing happens. The main box is dead.
text.brk.B1.on: Far away, office lights stutter on.
text.brk.B2.off: The hall lights die. All of them.
text.brk.B3.on: A loud buzz from the south. The water is singing.
text.brk.B4.on: An alarm wails through the level. The gate motor is running. So is something else.
text.repair.name: Main box
text.repair.unbolt.done: The cover swings open. The 30A slot is black and empty.
text.repair.fuse.done: It clicks in. The box warms up.
text.repair.done: The box hums awake. The breaker panel lights up.
text.hint.water.live: The water is crackling. Don't step in.
text.hint.first.note: A page torn from a notebook.
text.exit.locked: The door is warm. It isn't locked.
